parents.K4O_diagnosis: Full raw 1NN also misses genuinely useful action on unfamiliar contexts; FIT coreset decision optimization not transferable.

novel_hypothesis: A compact learned latent state of action-conditioned public observation transitions provides additional reusable decision information over direct reward-only fitting and episodic 1NN, using the same FIT episodes and heldout public reset observations.

source.original_runtime: Existing source-pinned CausalWorld and K4B in-memory deterministic physics repair only
source.task_constructor: Original CausalWorld public generate_task keyword-only task parameter; reaching goal xyz offsets, pushing object positions, novel picking tool_block_position offset.

cohort.action_rule: K4H low, center, high, mixed even20% odd80% 9 joint positions

fit_prerequisites: 12 distinct public FIT resets per training family
two distinct best realized action IDs on reaching FIT
all four arms per variant share the same reset observation
all public FIT final observations and step reward sums finite
all 3 task family source constructors accept frozen goal/object offsets

learning.shared_public_state: 128 real-valued tanh(observation/0.5) dimensions, zero padded. No variant IDs, simulator hidden task state, oracle labels or FIT/DEV reward leak to policy.
learning.algorithm: Per trained family, compute mean FIT reset state and SVD top six right singular vectors from 12 FIT reset states. Compute mean FIT final-minus-reset transition and SVD top four right singular vectors across 48 FIT transition examples. For each action fit ridge(lambda=1) to learn latent transition from [1, six reset state coordinates]. Then leave-one-FIT-variant-out transition fits to construct strictly out-of-fold predicted transitions for all FIT records. Fit per-action ridge(lambda=1) predicting real reward from [1, six reset coordinates, four OUT-OF-FOLD predicted transition coordinates]. At inference use only public reset, latent transition predictor, and reward head to select action. This is a compact learned predictive-state experiment, not a non-neural theoretical optimal state proof.
learning.leave_one_variant_out: Transition model trained on other 11 FIT variants per arm. Feature bases may be computed from all FIT, never CHECK/DEV. Out-of-fold reward regressor sees same FIT reward records but not its own transition target fitted in transition predictor.
learning.reward_baseline: Direct per-arm ridge(lambda=1) on six public reset SVD coordinates; stronger raw-128 ridge(lambda=1), full FIT raw 1-NN, FIT mean per-arm, full raw public RBF kernel ridge(kernel bandwidth fixed=0.25 and lambda=1), and fixed arm0.
learning.transition_ablation: FIT-only permute terminal transition labels across each arm using deterministic circular +1 FIT-variant shift, re-fit otherwise identical transition models; reward head fixed trained as above. This ablation is a diagnostic of reliance on learned dynamics, not a retrained end-to-end matched control.
learning.state_persistence: Serialize fitted mean, SVD bases, transition weights, reward head, direct and baseline weights to canonical JSON; reload in fresh same process before any CHECK/DEV action decisions and verify FIT predictions exactly identical.
learning.shared_zero_shot: For unfamiliar picking family, use equal-weight mean of reaching+pushing trained action predicted rewards normalized with each family's own FIT reward mean/std per action across all training outcomes. All conventional controls use same normalization, and no picking FIT data. Picking is distinct task family and may fail meaningful action diversity; never count picking as positive without source discrimination.

evaluation.no_tuning: Train once on FIT; CHECK veto/diagnostic only; do not retrain or alter thresholds on CHECK or DEV. Freeze all policy actions from public reset-only observations prior to first HELDOUT reward rollout.
evaluation.per_source: Full raw public initial and terminal features, physical public reward action consequences, origin SHA, recorded actual chosen action per method and actual reward, task family source identities.
evaluation.primary: On fresh reaching DEV, predictive_state improves actual reward over strongest of all fitted reward-only conventional controls by >=0.01, yields >=3/8 strict gains vs strongest comparator's chosen rewards and selects >=2 actions; in pushing must not lose >0.1 reward relative to best conventional. For independent genuinely unfamiliar picking: must outperform best conventional by >=0.01 mean reward with >=2 of 8 strict improvements, have >=2 observable distinct hindsight best actions, and select >=2 actions. All conditions required.
evaluation.predictive_dynamics: On reaching and pushing CHECK, action-conditioned predicted 4D latent transition squared error must be at least 5% lower than fixed FIT armwise mean latent delta; diagnostic alone cannot advance science.
evaluation.resource: Predictive-state checkpoint <=50% raw 1NN source records size, measured inference CPU <=200% raw 1NN inference CPU over 200 passes x 14 public contexts (all 3 families CHECK+DEV =30 contexts; 6000 requests/model). Measure shared fitting process CPU/wall, whole-run CPU/wall/RSS and full source episodes. No hidden energy claims.
evaluation.two_processes: Two fresh Python OS process results must exactly match source, learned state digests, actions, outcomes, science dispositions; timing excluded. Single GitHub host is not external replication.
evaluation.stop: If initial source reset identity or FIT reaching action diversity fails, stop without using any CHECK or DEV reward and preserve original negative; no second protocol/ad hoc correction to scientific cohorts.
